item.title: Saiyami Kher and Gulshan Devaiah reunite for soulful music video Aise Na Humko
item.description: Saiyami Kher and Gulshan Devaiah reunite in the soulful music video 'Aise Na Humko,' composed by Swanand Kirkire. Known for their chemistry in '8 A.M. Metro,' the duo brings emotional depth to this new project. Filmed in Nashik, the video captures a personal charm, with Saiyami expressing her admiration for Swanand's multifaceted talent and her comfort working with Gulshan.

item.title: Abhishek Banerjee pays tribute to Om Puri with a heartfelt cameo in Freedom at Midnight 2
item.description: In a touching tribute to the legendary Om Puri, actor Abhishek Banerjee delivers a heartfelt cameo in 'Freedom at Midnight 2', directed by Nikkhil Advani. Banerjee's role, inspired by Puri's iconic performance in 'Gandhi', resonates with audiences for its emotional depth and quiet impact. The actor emphasizes the significance of honoring Puri's legacy, highlighting the spirit of Indian cinema that values respect and contribution over individual gain.
